title: Phát âm & Shadowing — Câu so sánh

sentences.text: The air in the mountains is cleaner than the city air.
My brother’s new flat is smaller than mine, but its monthly rent is very low.
Journeys by metro always feel shorter than journeys by bus in the heavy Hanoi traffic.
The new metro line is more reliable than the old bus service.
Public transport in Singapore is more efficient than public transport in most Asian cities today.
My grandmother’s old recipes are more interesting than the recipes in modern cookery books today.
The new electric buses start earlier than the old diesel ones on my street every morning.
Farmers in the delta work harder than office staff during the two short harvest seasons.
Air quality in the old quarter falls faster than anywhere else in the city’s crowded centre.
Air pollution remains the most serious environmental problem in many large Asian capital cities today.
The old diesel buses in this city are the worst vehicles for local air quality.
The new solar power plant is the largest energy project in the whole northern region.
